sources.verification: Schema, source units, identity and import arithmetic checked; individual food chemistry was not independently remeasured.

sources.verification: Schema, source units, identity and import arithmetic checked; individual food chemistry was not independently remeasured.

methods.MA: Manufacturer supplied(industry or trade association), Analytical data, incomplete documentation
methods.MC: Manufacturer supplied; Calculated by manufacturer or unknown if analytical or calculated
methods.NR: Nutrient that is based on other nutrient/s; value used directly, ex. Nut.#204 from Nut.#298
methods.LC: Label claim (back calculated from label by NDL staff; Calculated from label claim/serving (g or %RDI)
methods.Z: Assumed zero (Insignificant amount or not naturally occurring in a food, such as fiber in meat)
methods.FLA: Estimated formulation based on ingredient list; Linear program used to estimate ingredients; Analytical data
methods.BFFN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Fat; Retention factors not used
methods.FLC: Estimated formulation based on ingredient list; Linear program used to estimate ingredients; Claim on label/serving
methods.FLM: Estimated formulation based on ingredient list; Linear program used to estimate ingredients; Manuf. Calc. data/100
methods.BFZN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; No adjustment; Retention factors not used
methods.BFSN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Solids; Retention factors not used
methods.AI: Analytical data; from the literature or  government;  incomplete documentation
methods.T: Taken from another source--other tables of food composition
methods.JO: Aggregated data involving combinations of data with different source codes when at least one code is not 1, 6, 12, or 13
methods.BFCN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Carbohydrate; Retention factors not used
methods.BFPN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Protein; Retention factors not used
methods.RPI: Recipe;Per package directions;No adjustments applied, combination of source codes which incl codes other than 1,12,or 6
methods.RPA: Recipe; Per package directions; No adjustments applied, combination of source codes 1, 12, and/or 6.
methods.RP: Recipe; Per package directions (ex. refrigerated dough, toast, cake mix)
methods.JA: Aggregated data involving combinations of data with only source codes 1 and 12 and/or 13
methods.RA: Recipe; Approximate ingredient proportions (ex. combination of several recipes)
methods.CAZN: Calculated from different food; From average values for food category; No adjustment; Retention factors not used
methods.BFNN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Non-fat solids; Retention factors not used
methods.BFYN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Yield; Retention factors not used
methods.BD: Based on same food; Drained solids from solids and liquids or vice versa (canned fruits and vegetables)
methods.PIK: Based on physical composition; Derived from imputed data; Known physical composition
methods.PAK: Based on physical composition; Derived from analytical data; Known physical composition
methods.PIE: Based on physical composition; Derived from imputed data; Estimated physical composition
methods.PAE: Based on physical composition; Derived from analytical data; Estimated physical composition
methods.RKI: Recipe;Known formulation;No adjustments applied, combination of source codes which includes codes other than 1,12,or 6
methods.RKA: Recipe; Known formulation; No adjustments applied, combination of source codes 1, 12, and/or 6.
methods.BNA: Based on another form of the same food or similar food: constituents normalized to total; vitamin A
methods.BFZY: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; No adjustment; Retention factors used
methods.RK: Recipe; Known formulation (dissection data or proprietary formulation)
methods.AR: Analytical data; derived by linear regression
methods.BFSY: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Solids; Retention factors used
methods.RF: Recipe; Formulary of standard products (formulary or standards of identity)
methods.CASN: Calculated from different food; From average values for food category; Solids; Retention factors not used
methods.BFNY: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Non-fat solids; Retentions factors used
methods.BFPY: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Protein; Retention factors used
methods.ML: Manufacturer supplied; Value upon which manufacturer based label claim for fortified/enriched nutrient
methods.S: Product standard, such as enrichment level specified in CFR or AMS commodity standard
methods.DA: Concentration adjustment using factor; derived from analytical data
methods.CAFN: Calculated from different food; From average values for food category; Fat; Retention factors not used
methods.BFAN: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Ash; Retention factors not used
methods.BFYY: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Yield; Retention factors used
methods.BFFY: Based on another form of the food or similar food; Concentration adjustment; Fat; Retention factors used

basis: Values per 100 g edible food; household measures are source-specific gram conversions.
searchDuplicatePolicy: Different source profiles retained; search collapses identical descriptions unless requested.
